Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to carry free-text supplementary usage or licensing guidance (schema:usageInfo) that does not fit the structured licence, permission, and duty model.

Avoid when

  • Avoid using it as a substitute for structured terms (model permissions, prohibitions, and duties as rules where they can be) and avoid putting the credit line here, which is gmeow:attributionText.

How to use

  • Set gmeow:usageInfo on the asset for prose that supplements the machine-readable licence; keep enforceable terms on gmeow:Permission / gmeow:Prohibition / gmeow:Duty.

Examples

  • ex:photo gmeow:usageInfo "Editorial use only; contact rights@example.com for commercial licensing.".
